shared_elements: rounded, dome-like upper contour of the worked stone
worked stone surface with raised/relief modelling
justification: The only correspondence is the broadly rounded, lobed silhouette of the worked upper part of each stone, a shape feature rather than shared iconography. A shows a volumetric, almost featureless double-bulbed sculptural form with at most crude schematic facial suggestions, while B presents a flat, densely linear panelled composition of horses, human figures and ribbon interlace framed by patterned borders — no figure, animal or motif is shared.
